01

VaultZero

Zero-knowledge encrypted vault with a dead-man switch. Secrets are encrypted in the browser with AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2 key derivation, so the server only ever stores ciphertext. Vaults release to a verified recipient after a set period of inactivity, with HMAC tamper detection, audit logs and email security alerts.

Movie ticket booking platform in the BookMyShow style. Interactive theatre seat layout with VIP rows, live seat availability, JWT auth, booking history and cancellations that release seats automatically, SMS tickets through Twilio, and an admin panel for movies, shows, bookings and revenue.

KaamOnClick

Hyperlocal service marketplace that connects customers with nearby plumbers, electricians, tutors and more. Customers post a job, providers in their state bid, and the customer picks the best offer. JWT auth with role-based users, a GraphQL API layer, and MySQL through Sequelize.
